subject: Re: GDPR DPA & SCC selection — post-demo follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: GDPR DPA & SCC selection — post-demo follow-up

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and appreciate the clear signals on risk and procurement next steps. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can stay aligned: 

Key points from the call:
- Acme Health will be the data controller for patient/PHI data; Redwood will act as processor for inference requests.
- You asked about our GDPR coverage (DPA + SCCs), SOC 2 status, and HIPAA support.
- You also requested we kick off the vendor security questionnaire and share a DPA draft we can review.

Proposed next steps (what I can action this week):
1) Send an editable DPA draft + SCC module recommendation (see attached).
2) Kick off the vendor security questionnaire — either via the attached PDF or your questionnaire link.
3) Loop in our security lead (Neha) and SE (Rishi) for any technical/controls questions.

SCC recommendation summary: based on the call and your role as controller, we recommend Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) of the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021). I included a short matrix in the attachment that explains why Module 2 is the right fit and the fallback options if you require Processor -> Processor mappings for sub-processors.

SOC 2 / HIPAA: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II (in-scope) — the latest report is available under NDA. We also support HIPAA compliance controls and will provide our Business Associate Agreement (BAA) template upon request.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx, SCC_Module_Selection_Matrix.xlsx, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

If that plan looks good, I’ll send the DPA + SCC selection to your legal team and start the questionnaire. Prefer to get the DPA reviewed and a confirmed SCC module so legal can move quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA & SCC selection — post-demo follow-up

Thanks Marissa — that recap is super helpful. Confirming a few things from our side:

- Acme Health is the controller; Redwood will be the processor for the inference pipeline.
- We agree that Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) SCCs are the expected starting point.
- We do need SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK under NDA) and the BAA template.

Tom and I will loop legal in to review the DPA. Please go ahead and send the DocuSign link when the DPA is ready. Also, we prefer the questionnaire as a shared editable file (we’ll push back if we need to import into our vendor portal).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking to keep legal review to 2 weeks if possible.

Elena
Director of Procurement | Acme Health
elena@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: FW: GDPR DPA & SCC selection — Acme Health (need quick review)

Neha / Rishi —

Forwarding Acme Health confirmation. They want Module 2 SCCs and have asked for SOC 2 report + BAA. Can you please review the attached DPA draft and SCC selection matrix and confirm:

1) Any redlines we should expect from legal (data residency, subprocessor list language, audit rights).
2) Whether the wording in section 4.2 (subprocessor onboarding) meets our standard practice or needs stronger limits.
3) Confirm availability to produce a SOC 2 report under NDA and provide a BAA template.

I attached the current DPA draft and the SCC matrix (both attached to this thread). I also attached the vendor questionnaire that Acme might use — please flag any tricky control questions so I can prep a short answers doc for legal.

Goal: Get your feedback by EOD tomorrow so I can upload the DPA to DocuSign and send the link to Acme Legal by Friday.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-03 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA & SCC selection — post-demo follow-up

Hi Elena / Tom / Legal team —

Quick update and next steps following our internal review: 

- SCC module: Confirmed Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) is appropriate for Acme Health -> Redwood. I attached the SCC_Module_Selection_Matrix.xlsx that calls this out and explains the fallback language for subprocessors.
- DPA: Draft attached (Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx). We’re prepared to accept reasonable customer redlines on data residency and audit rights; our standard subprocessor onboarding language is included but we can tighten it per your legal team's request.
- SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Neha, copied here, can coordinate the NDA and secure upload location.
- Vendor questionnaire: Attached as an editable PDF — I’ve also pulled answers to the high-impact sections and added them as comments. If you prefer, I can import to your portal but wanted to share the annotated copy first.

Next steps from Acme side (requested):
1) Legal to review DPA and confirm redlines (target 10 business days).
2) Execute NDA so we can share the SOC 2 report (we can start the NDA immediately).
3) Share any required additional SCC language or specific clauses your counsel needs.

If helpful, Neha and Rishi are available for a 30-min call with Acme Legal to walk through controls and technical architecture. Let me know preferred times and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks again — aiming to have the DocuSign DPA link to you by Friday afternoon pending any internal redlines.

Best,
